identity.remaining: Shared runtime is wired behind AUTH_RUNTIME=accountkit (off by default): exact code login scoped to its side, first-password claims and proof-gated linking through AccountKit's provisioning, revocable sessions read with role/site/unit reloaded per request, read-only borrowed views, and the existing screens served through the shared lifecycle. Open: the final locked import and switch of all credential writers, the self-serve household flow (off for AOZ), AccountKit's own account screens (passkeys, second factor, sessions), configured-provider journeys and deployed proof with an approved test identity. See docs/ACCOUNTKIT-MIGRATION.md.

design.remaining: AOZ retains its product palette and font adapter. Review remaining local layout primitives.

search.remaining: Every listed staff search ranks the already-authorized rows through searchText (src/lib/search/text-search.ts): role, site and filter restrictions stay in the SQL that loads them, so search only narrows. The learning board ranks up to 2000 scoped records before showing 200, and its counts follow the search. Exact code lookup at sign-in remains a domain credential, not fuzzy matching.

lists.remaining: SQL wildcard escaping and selection toggles use ListKit. Codec exception, owner @bitbaum/listkit, 2026-10-29: the client-filter URL codec (src/lib/config/client-filters.ts) stays local because ListKit's parseQuery/writeQuery have no viewer-relative defaults (the Zuständig default depends on the viewer's caseload) and no neutral override that keeps a saved group from re-applying a default. Moving it would lose both. Revisit when ListKit supports per-request defaults with neutral values.
